title: Inventory — Full Stack
description: Generated by scripts/dashboards/build.py from scripts/dashboards/spec.py — do not edit by hand. Merges the former 'Metrics to compare', 'PostgreSQL Metrics' and 'JVM & Spring' dashboards. Panels for the other variant family render empty by design.

panels.title: Request rate by endpoint & method
panels.description: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count)) by (uri, method). Replaces the separate per-family throughput panels the three old dashboards each had.

panels.title: POST /inventory/orders by status
panels.description: Admission outcome. On archived runs only the 202/non-202 split survives.

panels.title: Offered vs accepted vs terminal
panels.description: One axis, orders/s. Dashed = asked of the system, solid = done by it.

panels.title: In-flight orders (saturation)
panels.description: Admitted minus terminal. Monotonic growth on a constant-rate plateau is saturation.
